statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was billed
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to identify intermittent cardiac arrhythmias associated with the patient's transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The submitted clinical indication note supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure
